bug_semantics: Use-after-free of a live parent socket's BPF local storage on sock-clone early bailout. sock_copy() memcpy's struct sock except the sock_common dontcopy window; sk_bpf_storage sits near the end of struct sock, so the clone inherits the parent's pointer. If sk_clone()/sk_clone_lock() fails after sock_copy() and before that pointer is wiped or replaced (classic case: sk_filter_charge() fails when optmem_max changed), sk_free() -> __sk_destruct() -> bpf_sk_storage_free() destroys the parent's still-referenced bpf_local_storage.
flaw_origin: BIC 6ac99e8f23d4 first wrote sk_bpf_storage onto struct sock and hooked bpf_sk_storage_free() into __sk_destruct(). Immediate parent 3745dc24aa7a already has net/core/sock.c and include/net/sock.h, but those blobs have no sk_bpf_storage / bpf_sk_storage_free, and net/core/bpf_sk_storage.c does not exist. Pre-existing sk_clone_lock already did sock_copy then sk_free_unlock_clone() on sk_filter_charge/xfrm failure, so the new field plus destructor created the UAF without a NULL before those bailouts. f12dd75959b0 later NULLed the pointer only after the bailout; 8f51dfc73bf1 moved that NULL into bpf_sk_storage_clone(), still after the same bailouts. 151b98d10ef7 only split sk_clone_lock into sk_clone.
ai_marker: none; author Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com>, committer Alexei Starovoitov <ast@kernel.org>; no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot on the BIC object
evidence: CVE-2026-68399 is PUBLISHED on CVE.org (not rejected/withdrawn). Advisory and git describe a UAF: sock_copy() shallow-copies sk_bpf_storage; early sk_clone bailout before bpf_sk_storage_clone() leaves the clone pointing at the parent; sk_free/__sk_destruct/bpf_sk_storage_free then frees the parent's storage. Direct fix 7cbd0c4cebe4 (Matt Bobrowski / Daniel Borkmann, 2026-07-09) RCU_INIT_POINTER(newsk->sk_bpf_storage, NULL) immediately after sock_copy() in sk_clone() and drops the later NULL in bpf_sk_storage_clone(); stable backport is 14b49b5ab299 (Upstream commit 7cbd0c4cebe4). git cat-file -p 6ac99e8f23d4 and git log -1 --format='%an %ae %cn %ce' 6ac99e8f23d4: Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com> / Alexei Starovoitov <ast@kernel.org>. git cat-file -e 3745dc24aa7a:net/core/sock.c and include/net/sock.h succeed; parent tree lacks sk_bpf_storage and bpf_sk_storage_free; 3745dc24aa7a:net/core/bpf_sk_storage.c is absent. 6ac99e8f23d4 is a single-parent first-write of those lines, not a move/refactor/squash. ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: git show 3745dc24:net/core/sock.c and sock.h have 0 matches for bpf_sk_storage/sk_bpf_storage and net/core/bpf_sk_storage.c 'exists on disk, but not in 3745dc24'; the BIC 6ac99e8f introduces sk_bpf_storage in struct sock, the bpf_sk_storage_free(sk) call in __sk_destruct, and the sock_copy pointer aliasing that creates the UAF. -> introducer_parent_absent=true.
